summary: Explored compute-optimal depth/width under the fixed 5-min budget plus LR/schedule tuning, all at the given baseline architecture. Shallower DEPTH=6 was clearly worse (1.066) since fewer parameters outweighed the extra optimizer steps; deeper DEPTH=12 (with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=64 to avoid OOM) was roughly on par but slightly worse (1.015) than baseline. Raising MATRIX_LR to 0.055 at DEPTH=8 gave my best result (1.012919), essentially tied with the untouched baseline (1.012347) within noise; shorter LR warmdown and a window pattern with more full-context layers were both slightly worse. None of my 6 runs beat the baseline, suggesting the given hyperparameters are already well-tuned for this time budget; next I'd try architectural changes (e.g. different aspect ratio / head_dim, QK-norm variants, or a shorter time-budget-aware LR schedule sweep with multiple seeds to separate noise from signal) rather than more depth/LR sweeps.
